title: Design: Empty Credit Terms Log shows its empty line
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • No change has been saved on the Credit Terms page since release.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p1-15-credit-terms-log-empty.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" button beside "New Credit Term".
  2. Click "Audit Log".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the page menu opens.
  • Step 2: the log window shows its column headings and, centred under them in grey, "No history here. Yet." (as in ct-p1-15-credit-terms-log-empty.png).
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S12-E1: “When the log has no rows, the table shows the log's standard empty state, "No history here. Yet."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Credit Terms Log has no rows | "No history here. Yet." | Empty state in the table”
